import Base

def Life.tap(cells: List<&2, U32>, i: U32, inside: Bool) -> U32:
  +mask = Bool.to_u32(inside)
  U32.mul(mask,
    Maybe.default(&2, U32,
      List.get(&2, U32, cells, U32.to_nat(U32.mul(i, mask))), 0))

def Life.stencil(
  +width: U32, +height: U32, +board: List<&2, U32>,
  line: List<&2, U32>, +i: U32
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match line:
    case Nil{}:
      Nil{}
    case cell <> rest:
      +x = U32.mod(i, width)
      +y = U32.div(i, width)
      +north = U32.is_ne(y, 0)
      +south = U32.is_lt(U32.inc(y), height)
      +west = U32.is_ne(x, 0)
      +east = U32.is_lt(U32.inc(x), width)
      +up = U32.sub(i, width)
      +down = U32.add(i, width)
      +near = (
        Life.tap(board, U32.sub(up, 1), Bool.and(north, west)) +
        Life.tap(board, up, north) +
        Life.tap(board, U32.add(up, 1), Bool.and(north, east)) +
        Life.tap(board, U32.sub(i, 1), west) +
        Life.tap(board, U32.add(i, 1), east) +
        Life.tap(board, U32.sub(down, 1), Bool.and(south, west)) +
        Life.tap(board, down, south) +
        Life.tap(board, U32.add(down, 1), Bool.and(south, east))
        : U32)
      Bool.to_u32(
        Bool.or(
          U32.is_eq(near, 3),
          Bool.and(U32.is_eq(cell, 1), U32.is_eq(near, 2))))
        <> Life.stencil(width, height, board, rest, U32.inc(i))

def step(
  +width: U32, +height: U32, +cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  Life.stencil(width, height, cells, cells, 0)

def evolve(
  turns: Nat, +width: U32, +height: U32, cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match turns:
    case 0n:
      cells
    case 1n+more:
      evolve(more, width, height, step(width, height, cells))
